title: Advance Architect Block
description: It adds a new architect block, which you can use to create large buildings in ease and even visualize different structure pattern before building.
body:
# Architect Block **Design and visualize your builds in 3D before placing a single block!** ![Architect Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/690839b9a9b2f054b34539a1d5fee9fd3678a6ae.jpeg) --- ## 🏗️ Overview The **Architect Block** is a powerful building assistant that lets you plan, preview, and execute complex structures with ease. Simply place the block, design your build in a virtual 3D grid, load your materials, and watch your creation come to life! --- ## ✨ Features
📐 3D Grid Design System - Choose between **16x16x16** or **32x32x32** building grids - Navigate through layers with intuitive up/down controls - Color-coded blocks show your design at a glance - Gray cells indicate existing terrain that can't be overwritten ![Selection Grid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48f2dcfe3fb7c7a0551cd501335c1cf42c5ef80b_0.webp)
🎨 Visual Block Selection - 9-slot inventory for different block types - Right-click any slot to select it for drawing - Each slot displays with a unique color in the grid - Left-click or drag to place your selected block - If you want to draw multiple lines or blocks then drag with left click, and if you want to remove multiple selection then drag with right click ![Block Selection](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80706168edf80c15ea8a95ff5cde3584cfba72ef_0.webp)
⚡ One-Click Building - Click **BUILD** to construct your entire design instantly - Blocks are automatically consumed from the inventory - Clear error messages if you don't have enough materials - Design resets after building, ready for your next creation! ![Build Process](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2f12719ce8d454c529dc2804639c12809d7c668_0.webp)
🗺️ Terrain Awareness - Automatically scans the area in front of the block - Shows existing blocks as obstacles in your grid - Prevents accidental overwrites of existing structures - Perfect for building additions to existing builds - Also after you have build something, the block shall rescan and then gray out those occupied blocks also ![Terrain Scan](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50f5489e19fbbfd94920b8dd0f32e1acec985459_0.webp)
--- ## 📖 How to Use 1. **Craft** the Architect Block (recipe unlocks when you craft a Crafting Table) 2. **Place** the block facing the direction you want to build 3. **Right-click** to open the design interface 4. **Select** a grid size (16×16×16 or 32×32×32) 5. **Load** building materials into the 9-slot inventory 6. **Right-click** a material slot to select it 7. **Left-click** on the grid to place blocks in your design 8. **Right-click drag** on the grid to erase blocks 9. Click **BUILD** when ready! --- ## 🔧 Crafting Recipe ![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e643b86801b77909e5f1f5e39739133bb0916fee.png) --- ## 📦 Installation 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) 2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 3. Download the Architect Block JAR for your Minecraft version 4. Place the JAR in your `mods` folder 5. Launch Minecraft! --- ## 📜 License This mod is released under the **MIT License**. Feel free to include it in modpacks! ---
